task_goal: Land the lander on the landing pad at (0,0) as fast as possible with minimal fuel consumption.
reward_function_interface: def compute_reward(state, m_power, s_power, terminated) -> (float, dict)
state_space: 8-dimensional vector: [x, y, vx, vy, angle, angular_velocity, leg1_contact, leg2_contact]
action_space: Discrete: 0 (do nothing), 1 (fire left orientation engine), 2 (fire main engine), 3 (fire right orientation engine)
success_like_ending: Both legs in contact with ground (state[6]==1 and state[7]==1).
Lander is awake and not crashed.
behavior_trajectory_prior: Phase 1: Stabilize and approach the landing pad from above.
Phase 2: Descend with controlled vertical speed while maintaining horizontal alignment.
Phase 3: Final touchdown with minimal vertical velocity and upright orientation.
reward_design_risks: Hovering indefinitely at high altitude using main engine, never landing.
Landing far from pad but still upright (no crash) – satisfies soft landing but misses primary objective.
Excessive use of orientation engines causing oscillation or wasted fuel.
Landing with high vertical velocity but legs contact first – may be scored as success but is unsafe.
